project_type: React 18 + TypeScript SPA with Express backend
build_system: Vite for frontend, esbuild for server bundling
verification_instructions: 1. Run lint (tsc --noEmit). 2. Run build (vite build + esbuild). Both must pass with exit code 0.
setup_instructions: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh before any npm/node commands. Dependencies already installed in node_modules.
environment_constraints: Must run 'source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh' before ANY npm/node commands. Network mode: OPEN_INTERNET.
contribution_requirements: Commit with meaningful messages and push to main.
key_patterns: Pages use: useAppContext() for language state, t(en, mr) helper for bilingual text, motion from 'motion/react' for animations, lucide-react for icons. Login page uses cinematic pattern: full-screen bg image, dark overlay gradient, glassmorphic card with bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border-white/10.
directory_structure: src/pages/ = public pages, src/components/layout/ = layouts, src/components/ = shared components, src/contexts/ = AppContext
